items.title: CellPilot — AI agent for closed-loop cell culture
items.company: Team InstaLab, 24hr AI Science Cell Culture Hack @ Monomer Bio
items.description: With team InstaLab at Monomer Bio's 24-hour AI Science Cell Culture Hack, we built CellPilot: an AI agent that closes the loop between a scientist and a 6-axis UR12e robotic arm doing wet-lab cell culture. The agent reasons over live microscopy images and consults Elnora to make real-time decisions — harvest or split when cells are too dense, extend incubation when they're too sparse, and page the scientist immediately on suspected contamination. We also started a digital-twin framework so the workflow can be replayed and generalised across labs, not just this one bench.
outcomes: Best Overall (1st prize) at the 24-hour AI Science Cell Culture Hack @ Monomer Bio
0 → 1 in 24 hours: agent reasoning, microscopy vision, and robotic-arm control loop, live on demo day
Digital-twin framework started so the workflow can be replayed and adapted to other labs
